title: 52 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Phone Calls & Messages)
description:
Learn 52 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 52 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Phone Calls & Messages · 电话与短信
1:20  Asking for Directions · 问路
2:40  Patience · 耐心
4:01  Courage · 勇气
5:28  Love · 爱
6:53  Public Transportation · 公共交通
8:11  Weather & Small Talk · 天气与闲聊
9:30  Feelings & Emotions · 感受与情绪

PHRASE LIST

PHONE CALLS & MESSAGES · 电话与短信
• Are you free to talk right now? - 你现在方便通话吗？  [Nǐ xiànzài fāngbiàn tōnghuà ma?]
• Call me when you get this. - 你收到就给我打电话。  [Nǐ shōudào jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.]
• I can talk, text if needed. - 我可以打电话，你需要就发短信。  [Wǒ kěyǐ dǎ diànhuà, nǐ xūyào jiù fā duǎnxìn.]
• My phone is on silent right now. - 我这会儿手机静音了。  [Wǒ zhè huìr shǒujī jìngyīn le.]
• I’m calling you back now. - 我现在给你回电话。  [Wǒ xiànzài gěi nǐ huí diànhuà.]
• No worries, just reply when free. - 没事的，你有空再回我就行。  [Méi shì de, nǐ yǒu kòng zài huí wǒ jiù xíng.]

ASKING FOR DIRECTIONS · 问路
• Which direction should I face? - 我该朝哪个方向走？  [Wǒ gāi cháo nǎge fāngxiàng zǒu?]
• Is this the correct street? - 我在这条路上对吗？  [Wǒ zài zhè tiáo lù shàng duì ma?]
• Can you name the next landmark? - 下一个地标是哪里？  [Xià yí ge dìbiāo shì nǎlǐ?]
• What should I do at this corner? - 到这个路口我该怎么做？  [Dào zhège lùkǒu wǒ gāi zěnme zuò?]
• Should I turn left or right? - 我该左转还是右转？  [Wǒ gāi zuǒ zhuǎn háishì yòu zhuǎn?]
• Which bus can I take? - 我坐哪路公交车？  [Wǒ zuò nǎ lù gōngjiāo chē?]
• Is it walkable from here? - 从这里走过去方便吗？  [Cóng zhèlǐ zǒu guòqù fāngbiàn ma?]

PATIENCE · 耐心
• Stay steady, don t force it. - 稳住节奏，别硬推。  [wěn zhù jié zòu, bié yìng tuī]
• You can pause, no pressure. - 你可以先停一下，不用着急。  [nǐ kě yǐ xiān tíng yí xià, bú yòng zháo jí]
• Let it be imperfect, for now. - 先把它放着，不必求完美。  [xiān bǎ tā fàng zhe, bú bì qiú wán měi]
• Slow focus, answer will come. - 先别慌，专心想一想就有了。  [xiān bié huāng, zhuān xīn xiǎng yí xiǎng jiù yǒu le]
• Do one thing, then rest. - 做一点就好，累了就歇歇。  [zuò yí diǎn jiù hǎo, lèi le jiù xiē xiē]
• Keep showing up, even quietly. - 继续出现就行，哪怕很安静。  [jì xù chū xiàn jiù xíng, nǎ pà hěn ān jìng]

COURAGE · 勇气
• Say it, even if your voice shakes - 就算声音发抖 也把话说出来  [Jiùsuàn shēngyīn fādǒu, yě bǎ huà shuō chūlái]
• Request help, you deserve support - 开口求助吧, 你值得被帮助  [Kāikǒu qiúzhù ba, nǐ zhídé bèi bāngzhù]
• Make the call, worry can wait - 先把电话打出去, 担心可以晚点再说  [Xiān bǎ diànhuà dǎ chūqù, dānxīn kěyǐ wǎndiǎn zài shuō]
• Walk away, keep your dignity - 转身离开, 也要守住尊严  [Zhuǎnshēn líkāi, yě yào shǒuzhù zūnyán]
• Protect your boundaries, no apology - 守住边界, 不用一再道歉  [Shǒuzhù biānjiè, búyòng yīzài dàoqiàn]
• Start again, mistakes don’t define you - 重新开始, 错误不会决定你是谁  [Chóngxīn kāishǐ, cuòwù bú huì juédìng nǐ shì shéi]

LOVE · 爱
• I want to build with you - 我想和你一起建未来  [wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ yìqǐ jiàn wèi lái]
• I’m yours, genuinely and fully - 我愿意把自己交给你  [wǒ yuàn yì bǎ zìjǐ jiāo gěi nǐ]
• Your comfort is my home - 你的温暖就是我的家  [nǐ de wēn nuǎn jiù shì wǒ de jiā]
• Let me be your safe place - 让我成为你的避风港  [ràng wǒ chéng wéi nǐ de bì fēng gǎng]
• I’ll pick you in hard seasons - 难的时候我也先想你  [nán de shí hou wǒ yě xiān xiǎng nǐ]
• We fit, even when plans change - 计划变了我们也能对上  [jì huà biàn le wǒ men yě néng duì shàng]
• I like the way you listen - 我喜欢你认真听我说  [wǒ xǐ huān nǐ rèn zhēn tīng wǒ shuō]

PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION · 公共交通
• Which bus takes me to work - 哪路公交到我上班的地方？  [Nǎ LÙ GōNGJIāO DÀ WǑ SHÀNGBĀN DE DÌFāNG]
• Is there a night bus - 有夜班公交吗？  [Yǒu YÈBān GōNGJIāO MA]
• How do I buy a ticket - 我在哪里可以买票？  [WǑ Zài NǎLǏ MǎI Piào]
• Can I use my student card - 学生卡可以用吗？  [XuéSHēng Kǎ KěYǐ Yòng MA]
• Do I need to tap in - 进站要刷卡吗？  [Jìn Zhàn Yào Shuā Kǎ MA]
• Where can I recharge my card - 我的卡在哪里充值？  [Wǒ DE Kǎ Zài NǎLǐ ChōngZhí]
• Does this route go downtown - 这趟车去市中心吗？  [Zhè Tàng Chē Qù Shì Zhōngxīn MA]

WEATHER & SMALL TALK · 天气与闲聊
• What’s the forecast for tomorrow? - 明天的预报怎么样？  [Míngtiān de yùbào zěnme yàng?]
• Is it going to rain soon? - 等会儿会不会下雨？  [Děnghuìr huì bù huì xiàyǔ?]
• The sky looks so bright! - 天空看起来好晴朗。  [Tiānkōng kàn qǐlái hǎo qínglǎng.]
• How’s the air quality today? - 今天空气质量怎么样？  [Jīntiān kōngqì zhìliàng zěnme yàng?]
• It’s pleasantly cool right now. - 现在挺凉快的。  [Xiànzài tǐng liángkuai de.]
• Sun’s out, feel that warmth. - 太阳出来了，真暖和。  [Tàiyáng chūlái le, zhēn nuǎnhuo.]
• Is there fog in the morning? - 早上会起雾吗？  [Zǎoshang huì qǐ wù ma?]

FEELINGS & EMOTIONS · 感受与情绪
• I’m nervous about the meeting. - 我对会议有点紧张。  [Wo dui huiyi you DIAN JIN ZHANG.]
• Right now, I feel irritated. - 我现在有点烦。  [Wo xian zai you DIAN FAN.]
